Conclusions
Legumes are an excellent alternative to increase the protein consumption in more sustainable diets. Pulses are in a transition from
being considered the “meat of the poor” thanks to their incorporation as food ingredients. Resistant starch, micronutrients and
phytochemicals are legumes components that have beneﬁcial effects beyond nutrition. Pulses commonly consumed around the
globe are very diverse and this contributes with healthy diets maintaining ethnic foods and promoting innovative uses thanks to
emerging technologies.
